title: Implement Request Logging with Error Handling
description: This feature adds logging capabilities to track incoming requests and errors, allowing for better debugging and issue resolution. It will include error handling to ensure that logging does not disrupt the application. This will improve the overall reliability and maintainability of the framework
testCases: Test logging for failed requests with error handling
acceptance: The feature is accepted when all test cases pass and logging is successfully implemented without disrupting the application
reason: Implementing request logging with error handling is crucial for a production-ready framework like Yantraverse, as it enables developers to identify and resolve issues efficiently, ultimately improving the user experience
